features.subtitle: POWERFUL FEATURES

scan.title: AI Ingredient Scan
scan.description: Point your camera at any ingredient list. Our AI analyzes every component and provides an instant halal ruling based on your chosen madhhab.

verified.title: Product Verification

prayer.title: Prayer Times & Qibla

cosmetics.description: Verify cosmetics and beauty products for halal compliance. Analyze ingredients that may contain animal-derived or alcohol-based components.

watch.title: Apple Watch Companion

madhhab.subtitle: YOUR PRACTICE. YOUR MADHHAB.
madhhab.title: Tailored to Your School of Thought
madhhab.description: AllHalal respects the diversity of Islamic jurisprudence. Choose your madhhab and receive rulings that align with your practice.

general.name: General
general.description: Universal rulings accepted across all schools. Perfect for those who prefer broadly agreed-upon halal classifications without school-specific interpretations.

hanafi.name: Hanafi
hanafi.description: The largest school of Islamic jurisprudence, followed by approximately 30% of Muslims worldwide. Known for its systematic methodology and extensive use of reason.
hanafi.regions: Turkey, Central Asia, South Asia, Balkans

shafii.name: Shafi'i
shafii.description: Known for its balanced methodology between textual sources and reasoning. Followed extensively in Southeast Asia, East Africa, and parts of the Middle East.

maliki.name: Maliki
maliki.description: Emphasizes the practices of the people of Medina as an additional source. Predominant in North and West Africa, and historically in Al-Andalus.

hanbali.name: Hanbali
hanbali.description: Known for its strict adherence to the Quran and Hadith. Followed primarily in Saudi Arabia and Qatar, with growing influence globally.

support.title: Support Center
support.subtitle: HELP & SUPPORT
support.description: Find answers to common questions or get in touch with our support team.

verification.question: How does AllHalal verify products?
verification.answer: AllHalal uses a combination of AI-powered ingredient analysis and a comprehensive database of over 2 million verified products. Our system analyzes ingredients, E-numbers, and additives to determine halal status based on Islamic dietary guidelines.

madhhab.question: Which madhhab (school of thought) does AllHalal follow?
madhhab.answer: AllHalal supports all four major Sunni schools of Islamic jurisprudence: Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, and Hanbali, plus a General option for commonly accepted rulings. You can select your preferred madhhab in the app settings, and all rulings will be tailored accordingly.

languages.question: Is AllHalal available in my language?
languages.answer: AllHalal is available in 9 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Arabic, and Urdu. The app automatically detects your device language.

accuracy.question: How accurate is the barcode scanner?
accuracy.answer: Our barcode scanner has a 99%+ recognition rate for products in our database. If a product is not found, you can use the AI ingredient scanner to analyze the ingredients list directly from the packaging.

offline.question: Can I use AllHalal offline?
offline.answer: Some features require an internet connection for real-time verification. However, previously scanned products and basic functionality are available offline.

report.question: How do I report an incorrect product listing?
report.answer: If you find an incorrect listing, please email us at app@allhalal.info with the product name, barcode, and the issue you've identified. Our team reviews all reports within 48 hours.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes. We follow industry-standard security practices including encryption, secure data storage, and strict access controls. We never sell your personal data. Read our Privacy Policy for complete details.

delete.question: How can I delete my account?
delete.answer: You can request account deletion by emailing app@allhalal.info with the subject "Account Deletion Request". We will process your request within 30 days as required by GDPR.
